title: ギリギリ駐車 ～PARK IT!～
subtitle: 角度よし、強さよし……たぶん。
core_mechanic: one-use finite braking on committed arc
one steering reversal per complete run, exact continuous piecewise circular arcs
duration_note: V4 design hypothesis; no extra mandatory input in first3 parks; human timing pending
primary_score: precision and perfect-streak × forbidden 2 × challenge 1.4; successful no-brake +10%, successful near misses capped20
escalation_mechanic: After ten successes, one frozen choice offers permanently narrow forbidden spaces or ordinary parking.
risk_reward: First3 parked cars use angle and power only. After3 successes optional finite brake and one steering correction unlock alongside safe/challenge bays. After10 successes frozen forbidden choice multiplies later scores by2.
visual_identity: project car art, bright mint parking bays, full-width phone board and large instruments
